articles.title: What Is Talk Time? Call Center Meaning, Prepaid Balance and Battery Specs
articles.excerpt: Talk time has three common meanings. In a call center, it is how long an agent and a customer spend in conversation on a call, usually reported as an average. On a prepaid phone plan, in markets such…
articles.body: Talk time has three common meanings. In a call center, it is how long an agent and a customer spend in conversation on a call, usually reported as an average. On a prepaid phone plan, in markets such as India, it is the money balance you can spend on calls, not a set number of minutes. On a phone's spec sheet, it is how many hours the battery lasts during calls. This guide explains all three. It starts with the call center meaning, which works the same way everywhere, and shows a business how to read talk time without pushing agents to rush. It then uses India's prepaid recharge rules as a worked example of the balance meaning. Note: Key takeaways In a call center, talk time has no single definition.

articles.title: Multi-Tenant RAG Data Isolation
articles.excerpt: Short answer: Multi-tenant RAG data isolation means every request, job and session carries a tenant ID that the server has verified, and every retrieval query, cache, file link and background job uses…
articles.body: Short answer: Multi-tenant RAG data isolation means every request, job and session carries a tenant ID that the server has verified, and every retrieval query, cache, file link and background job uses it. Enforce the scope in the database with row-level security as well as in application filters, and test it with two synthetic workspaces. How do you establish a trusted tenant context? Every RAG request, job and session needs a trusted tenant context. A route may identify which workspace the user wants, but the server must verify current membership and the requested permission before turning that selection into an authorized tenant ID. Apply tenant and document permissions inside vector and lexical candidate selection. Use the same scope for reranking inputs, citations and document reads.

articles.title: Prompt Injection Attack: How AI Agents Get Tricked
articles.excerpt: Prompt Injection Attack: How AI Agents Get Tricked What a prompt injection attack looks like in an agent If you build or use AI agents, a prompt injection attack is the threat to understand first. An…
articles.body: Prompt Injection Attack: How AI Agents Get Tricked What a prompt injection attack looks like in an agent If you build or use AI agents, a prompt injection attack is the threat to understand first. An agent mixes two kinds of input: trusted context (the user's request and the developer's instructions) and untrusted context (web pages, files, messages and tool results). Models read both as text, so instructions hidden in the untrusted part can compete with the real ones. Google's developer team calls the goal user intent hijacking: getting the agent to act on an attacker's intent instead of the user's. The poisoned bill, in numbers Google ran the public AgentDojo benchmark (97 user tasks, 949 attacked runs, six full runs per configuration) with a gemini-2.5-flash agent.

articles.body: The page reads: SMS event notifications for password resets are still queued as their tokens approach expiry. In this illustrative gaming runbook, the on-call sees possible delivery failures, a message identifier, and an old observation timestamp. Check sender registration before blaming carrier filtering or approving a resend. The missing registration evidence for the destination market changes the next action: investigate the sender configuration before sending another copy. Short answer: troubleshoot SMS event notification failures by checking sender registration and signatures first, then poll status and events to separate queued, delivered, failed, and carrier-rejected outcomes. For a short-lived password reset, keep those observations beside the identity decision and expiry.

articles.title: Why env() returns null in production after php artisan config:cache
articles.excerpt: It works on your laptop. You deploy. Now your API key is null, and nothing in the code changed. Very often the reason is one function: env(). In production most Laravel apps run this during deploy: ph…
articles.body: It works on your laptop. You deploy. Now your API key is null , and nothing in the code changed. Very often the reason is one function: env() . What config:cache does In production most Laravel apps run this during deploy: php artisan config:cache It takes every file in config/ and writes them into one cached PHP file. Laravel loads that one file instead of many, so every request starts a bit faster. There is one side effect. Once the config is cached, Laravel does not load your .env file anymore. The Laravel docs say it directly: after caching, env() only returns real system level environment variables. So any env() call outside config/ now reads from nothing.

articles.title: Cosmic 'betta fish' glows in spectacular nebula portrait | Space photo of the day for Nov. 26, 2026
articles.excerpt: The striking blue of the Betta Fish Nebula swims across the cosmic landscape in a new image from the Dark Energy Camera.
articles.body: An image captured by the Dark Energy Camera showcasing the Betta Fish Nebula. (Image credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/DOE/NSF/AURA) The striking blue of the Betta Fish Nebula swims across the cosmic landscape, a stunning wisp of material leftover from a stellar explosion. What is it? Roughly 6,800 light-years from Earth and nestled in the Centaurus constellation, this piece of the supernova remnant SNR G295.5+09.7 has earned the nickname the Betta Fish Nebula for its floaty, fishy shape. This almost ghostly whirl of gas and dust was created when a star much more massive than our sun exploded, blasting its outer layers of material outward in the process. Over time, the remnants of this supernova eruption stretched outward into space, dispersing and colliding with surrounding gas.

Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Eye in the Sky: The Milky Way over Lençóis Explanation: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. And there is much to behold in today’s featured image . The Milky Way shines bright in the sky of Brazil , over the white sand dunes and dark lagoons of Lençóis Maranhenses National Park . We can see different parts of the Milky Way as it apparently rotates in the sky every night and throughout the year.
